svg.title: Neoptolemos leading Polyxena to the tomb of Achilles
svg.desc: Line drawing after the 1850 plate of a black-figure vase in Berlin (Gerhard, Trinkschalen und Gefässe II, Taf. XVI): Neoptolemos leads veiled Polyxena to the tomb of Achilles, with a snake and a dog at the tomb and the winged shade of Achilles above; cut out and retraced.
